name: Cobot guidewire
group: DGIST (Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology) and its spin-off IMsystem, with UMass Amherst, EPFL and Kyungpook National University (kim2026_magnetic affiliations, read by P6 from PMC13410658); 2022 ECMIS: DGIST (Hongsoo Choi, PI), Hanyang University ERICA (Byung-Ju Yi, advancer), Seoul National University Bundang Hospital, Seoul St. Mary's Hospital and ETH Zurich (hwang2022_ecmis p. 1, 14)
versions: 2022 ECMIS (hwang2022_ecmis, Adv. Healthc. Mater.): eight-coil hemispherical electromagnetic actuation system under a carbon-composite bed, biplane C-arms, magnetic tip on a 0.014-in wire, Hanyang 5-DOF master-slave advancer, 2 swine -> 2026 Cobot guidewire (kim2026_magnetic): 8-coil system with IMsystem, phantom and swine. The link is inferred from the shared DGIST / IMsystem authors (S. Jeon, J.-y. Kim) and the eight-coil design; ECMIS is not named 'Cobot'; 2018-19: DGIST (S. Jeon, H. Choi) magnetic soft guidewire tip steered in MiniMag (Jeon 2018 Micro Nano Syst. Lett.) and OctoMag (Jeon 2019 Soft Robot.), phantoms (Hwang 2020 Figs. 7a-b; Konda 2025 Table 2 row 3) (hwang2020_review; konda2025_robotically)
target_anatomy: neuro (2026, phantom and swine); coronary, iliac and renal arteries (2022 ECMIS, swine)
devices_driven: 2026: guidewire with permanent magnet and magnetic polymer tip, tip OD 0.4 mm (kim2026_magnetic, per P6 notes); 2022: 400 um x 10 mm tip unit (3 mm NdFeB magnet + magnetic polymer in a silicone tube) on a 0.014-in Fielder FC guidewire; the advancer moves the guidewire and a 6 F guiding catheter (hwang2022_ecmis p. 4, 8, 12)
n_dof_detail: 2022: coil system gives 5-DOF magnetic control (3 translation, 2 rotation); advancer = Hanyang 5-DOF slave robot used for insertion and retraction (hwang2022_ecmis p. 8); 2026 N.R.
translation_detail: magnetic (steering); 2022 insertion by the motorised master-slave advancer (hwang2022_ecmis p. 8)
device_range: 2022: tip steers over 90 degrees at 5-15 mT (hwang2022_ecmis p. 4)
footprint_mm: 2022 coil workspace about 15 x 15 x 15 cm3 at up to 15 mT (hwang2022_ecmis p. 8); 2026: 150 mm cube of open volume with a uniform-field 52 mm cube, 30 mT used (kim2026_magnetic, per P6 notes)
haptics_leader: 2022: C++/Qt GUI from a shielded control booth, haptics N.R. (hwang2022_ecmis p. 8)
imaging_compat: 2022: biplane C-arms (floor and ceiling) with flat-panel detectors; the X-ray beam passes a central hole in the coil array; no electromagnetic interference observed (hwang2022_ecmis p. 8, 12)
validation_detail: 2026: phantom (n = 7) and swine (n = 11) procedures vs a manual wire (kim2026_magnetic, per P6 notes); 2022: 2D phantom on OctoMag (4 repeats), 3D silicone phantom (3 repeats), 2 crossbred pigs (about 30 kg): iliac, circumflex and LAD with an artificial occlusion in swine 1, renal in swine 2; access by hand, then teleoperated by engineers (hwang2022_ecmis p. 6-13)
key_numbers: 2026: procedure time 49.57 +- 19.61 vs 103.29 +- 68.18 s manual in phantom (p = 0.085), 22.36 +- 7.09 vs 79.63 +- 49.07 s in swine (p = 0.0033) (kim2026_magnetic, per P6 notes); 2022: friction coefficient 10.68 -> 0.09; 3D phantom right-coronary target 26 +- 4.04 s; operator dose rate in the booth < 11 uSv/h (hwang2022_ecmis)
sim_model: 2022: analytical Euler-Bernoulli tip model solved by Newton-Raphson (hwang2022_ecmis p. 13); no simulator
